stops.note: an edible fungus, perhaps from mousse 'moss', though the source is uncertain
Middle English musseroun was reshaped as if made of 'mush' and 'room'; in The Tempest (1611) Prospero speaks of elves whose pastime is to make 'midnight mushrumps'

current_meaning: a fungus with a domed cap on a stalk, often edible
